summary: Recent discussions in the Parquet community focus on refining storage recommendations and improving reader efficiency. Contributors are debating updates to the recommended row group size, proposing the removal of the 8 KB page size guideline, and adding uncompressed page size metadata to the OffsetIndex to help readers bound memory usage. Parallel threads examine encoding performance with PFOR-based integer encodings and clarify the interpretation of FILE logical types when both inline data and a URI are present.

highlights.text: Proposed update to the recommended Parquet row group size
Discussion to remove the 8 KB page size recommendation from documentation
Proposal to include uncompressed page size and dictionary page size in the Parquet OffsetIndex for memory‑bound readers
